##### Project general facts

Elara by Durar Group is a premium beachfront development located on Al Marjan Island, offering studios and 1–3 bedroom apartments. The project is designed to maximize panoramic sea views, with most residences enjoying direct vistas of the ocean. Its contemporary architectural concept blends elegant coastal aesthetics with modern lines, creating a refined seaside living environment.

The development offers a wide selection of resort-style amenities designed to elevate everyday living. Residents can enjoy a private urban sand beach club with a crystal lagoon, a spa and wellness center, a poolside bar, a cinema, as well as curated retail and dining options within the community. A fully equipped fitness center with a yoga studio and virtual training facilities further enhances the active lifestyle, complemented by premium services such as 24/7 butler service, housekeeping, valet parking, and chauffeur-driven car rental.

The interiors are fully finished using high-quality materials, with both exterior and interior design crafted by the award-winning WATG and Bismut & Bismut. The kitchens are equipped with appliances, offering functionality alongside style. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Additionally, Al Marjan Island is a hub for entertainment and leisure activities. It hosts various events and festivals throughout the year, including concerts, fireworks displays, and cultural celebrations. The island also features a dedicated area for outdoor fitness activities and jogging tracks, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
